# Simply Contact

> > Simply Contact is a multilingual outsourcing contact center providing 24/7 customer support, content moderation, and community management services across gaming, IT, and SaaS industries.

Simply Contact operates across multiple European locations including Poland, United Kingdom, Ukraine, Romania, Moldova, and Bulgaria. The company specializes in omnichannel customer service, trust and safety solutions, and player experience enhancement for gaming companies.

## Key Topics

- Multilingual support
- 24/7 customer service
- Gaming customer support
- IT customer support
- Player experience
- Content moderation
- Community management
- Trust and safety
- Omnichannel service
- Outsourcing contact center
- SaaS support
- European operations (Poland, UK, Ukraine, Romania, Moldova, Bulgaria)
- Service inquiries
- Career opportunities

## Industry Solutions

- [Gaming Customer Support - Boost Player Experience](https://simplycontact.com/industries/gaming-customer-support): Gaming customer support: 24/7 multilingual service for player experience
- [Клієнтська підтримка для ІТ-компаній](https://simplycontact.com/ua/industries/it-customer-service): IT customer support for SaaS companies (Ukrainian language version)
